description: Get a restaurant's BringMeThat menu: sections, items with item_id, descriptions, prices, and option groups (including which ones are required). Prices are item prices; checkout adds the fees create_checkout_link describes. Use restaurant_id from search_restaurants. Large menus can be narrowed with section or search.

search.description: Only items whose name or description contains this, e.g. 'vegetarian'.

section.description: Only sections whose name contains this, e.g. 'noodles'.

name: get_menu
title: Get a menu
